items.title: 4.1.7.2 Types of Trees (Binary Tree, AVL Trees) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of types of trees (PDF 111-112).

items: Binary tree: har node ke zyada se zyada do bachche, baen aur daen. Khandani misal mein Grandparent jarr hai jis ke bachche Parent1 aur Parent2, aur har parent ke apne bachche jaise Child1 aur Child2 ho sakte hain (Figure 4.9).

AVL tree: aisa binary tree jo khud ko mutawazin rakhta hai. Ek taraf doosri se bohat oonchi ho jaye to tree khud ko dobara tarteeb deta hai. 20 jarr wali misal mein baen taraf 15, 10 aur 18 aur daen taraf 30 hai, aur height ka farq kam se kam rehta hai (Figure 4.10).

blocks.alt: Teeron se jure dairon ka binary tree: oopar Grandparent se Parent2 aur Parent1; Parent2 se Child4 aur Child3; Parent1 se Child2 aur Child1.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.9: Khandani tree ki binary tree shakal (kitab ki Figure 4.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Teeron wala AVL tree: oopar 20; us ka baen bachcha 15, jis ke neeche baen 10 aur daen 18; 20 ka daen bachcha 30.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.10: AVL tree (kitab ki Figure 4.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; matan ke mutabiq 15, 10, 18 baen aur 30 daen).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 4.10 mein 30 baen taraf aur 15 daen taraf hai, aur 15 ke neeche 18 baen aur 10 daen. Magar kitab ka matan kehta hai ke baen taraf 15, 10, 18 aur daen taraf 30 hai; aur AVL tree mein chhoti qeemat baen aur bari daen jati hai. Is liye durust shakal yeh hai: 20 ke baen 15 (us ke baen 10, daen 18) aur daen 30. Baen shaakh ki height 2 aur daen ki 1 hai; farq sirf 1, is liye tree mutawazin (balanced) hai.

blocks.prompt: AVL misal mein 20 ki dono shaakhon ki heights kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Baen shaakh (15 aur us ke bachche 10 aur 18) ki height 1 aur daen shaakh (30) ki 0; farq 1 hai, to tree mutawazin hai.

items: Binary tree: har node ke zyada se zyada do bachche. AVL tree: khud ko mutawazin rakhne wala binary tree.
